raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "design-domain outline and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Fig. 1(a) identifies the domain by dark-gray shading. The caption gives 30×60 elements but no verbal outline, physical dimensions, or assumption of square elements.",
      "readings": [
        "Full rectangle with width/height = 2",
        "Full rectangle with width/height = 1/2",
        "Full rectangle with width/height = 1, using rectangular elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute in-plane length scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Fig. 1's caption nor the structural settings specify physical lengths or a length unit.",
      "readings": [
        "Height = 1 in normalized units",
        "Height = 30 mm, with width set by the chosen aspect ratio",
        "Height = 300 mm, with width set by the chosen aspect ratio"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "axis assignment and coordinates of the 30×60 grid",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Figs. 1 and 2 give element counts without assigning them to horizontal and vertical directions or specifying uniform spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "60 columns and 30 rows, uniformly spaced",
        "30 columns and 60 rows, uniformly spaced",
        "60 columns and 30 rows, with x_i/L = (i/60)^2 and uniformly spaced rows"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite-element formulation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text specifies finite elements and elementwise densities but gives no element order, displacement interpolation, or quadrature for Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization",
        "Nine-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial support of the lower-right load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Fig. 1 calls the load distributed while locating it at a corner, without defining a loaded edge, patch length, or set of nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "A lumped force at the lower-right corner node",
        "A load over the lowest one-element segment of the right edge",
        "A load over the lowest 10% of the right edge",
        "A load over the rightmost one-element segment of the bottom edge"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "load profile and equivalent nodal forces",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "For the distributed interpretation of Fig. 1, no traction profile or rule for assembling nodal forces is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform traction, assembled with consistent equivalent nodal forces",
        "Equal downward forces at every selected boundary node",
        "Triangular traction increasing toward the lower-right corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "normalization of the distributed 1 N load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Fig. 1 gives 1 N but does not explicitly distinguish the resultant of the distributed load from the force assigned to each loaded node.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant = 1 N across the selected nodes",
        "Each of m equally loaded nodes receives 1 N, giving a resultant of m N"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "non-design material at the clamp or load attachment",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No passive-cell mask or attachment-pad rule is stated for Fig. 1; the unavailable image cannot be checked for such regions.",
      "readings": [
        "All domain cells are designable; no passive regions",
        "A one-element solid pad at the lower-right load attachment",
        "A one-element-wide solid strip along the fixed left boundary"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid elastic stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 3.1 and Appendix A supply no Young's modulus or equivalent overall stiffness scale for Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 in consistent normalized units",
        "E0 = 70 GPa",
        "E0 = 210 GPa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "elastic symmetry and dimensionless constitutive properties",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No constitutive tensor, isotropy statement, or Poisson ratio is given for the structural example.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic material with Poisson ratio 0.3",
        "Isotropic material with Poisson ratio 0.25",
        "Grid-aligned orthotropic material with Ex/Ey = 2, nu_xy = 0.25, nu_yx = 0.125, and Gxy/Ey = 0.4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional elastic reduction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The Introduction calls Fig. 1 a 2-D cantilever, but neither the caption nor Section 3.1 specifies its constitutive reduction.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is stated for Fig. 1. The later five-element thickness concerns a separate 3-D experiment.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen consistent units",
        "Uniform thickness of 1 mm",
        "Uniform thickness of 5 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "density-to-stiffness interpolation and penalization schedule",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Introduction mentions SIMP as common practice, but Eq. (13) leaves K(rho) unspecified and gives no interpolation parameters for Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "SIMP with fixed exponent 3",
        "SIMP with fixed exponent 4",
        "SIMP with the exponent increased from 1 to 3 during optimization",
        "RAMP interpolation with parameter 5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "void or ersatz stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The density lower bound is discussed, but no independent stiffness floor or solid-to-void stiffness ratio is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "No independent floor: E(rho) = E0 rho^q",
        "E(rho) = Emin + (E0 - Emin) rho^q, with Emin/E0 = 1e-9",
        "The same additive-floor law with Emin/E0 = 1e-6"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "minimum admissible element density",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Section 2 gives approximately 1e-6 only as an example; Section 3.1 requires a small positive lower bound without fixing its value.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_min = 1e-6",
        "rho_min = 1e-3",
        "rho_min = 1e-9"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter kernel and distance metric",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 fixes the radius at 2.5 element sizes, but supplies no filter formula or distance metric.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized conical weights max(0, 2.5 - d), using Euclidean distance in grid units",
        "Normalized constant weights within Euclidean radius 2.5",
        "Normalized constant weights within Chebyshev distance 2.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No rule is given for filter neighborhoods that extend beyond the design domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the neighborhood and renormalize the retained weights",
        "Extend density by zero outside the domain and retain the full-kernel normalization",
        "Reflect the density field across the boundary before filtering"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "density field used in the 0.5 volume constraint",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (13) writes volume using rho, while Section 3 distinguishes unfiltered variables from filtered material densities. No separate notation resolves which field enters the implemented volume constraint.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain the mean unfiltered design density to at most 0.5; use filtered density for stiffness",
        "Constrain the mean filtered physical density to at most 0.5; use that density for stiffness"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA move limit for the Fig. 1 optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 does not specify a move limit. Fig. 3 explicitly introduces a later reduction, while Section 3.1 assigns 0.2 specifically to the Fig. 10 solutions.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant move limit 0.2",
        "Constant move limit 0.1",
        "Constant move limit 0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "remaining MMA parameter choices",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The caption and Appendix A name MMA and its original code, but do not give the asymptote parameters or approximation coefficients used for Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial asymptote span 0.5, expansion factor 1.2, contraction factor 0.7, constraint coefficients c = 1000 and d = 0",
        "Initial asymptote span 0.25, expansion factor 1.1, contraction factor 0.7, constraint coefficients c = 100 and d = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "early stopping and convergence criterion",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 specifies a maximum of 100 iterations, but gives no earlier stopping criterion or tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Perform exactly 100 optimization updates",
        "Stop when the maximum element-density change is below 0.01, or after 100 updates",
        "Stop when relative compliance change is below 1e-3, or after 100 updates"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "linear-elastic state solver accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text gives K(rho)u = f but no linear solution method or residual tolerance; Appendix A supplies only implementation attributions.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct solution to machine precision",
        "Conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
